description: The CISP has documented Hardware and Media protection procedures
The CISP has documented Software protection procedures
The CISP has documented Configuration Management procedures including handling of emergency changes
The organisation has a documented Continuity Planning procedure
An Identity and Access Management policy which specifies the access control schema is developed
The CISP has a documented CIS Security Incident Response procedures
Areas where NATO classified information is stored or processed, and areas housing CIS supporting services, are compliant with reference I or national equivalent to reference I
